typesense:trending.greeting:
Being her best friend for years meant watching her fall for other people over and over again. He hated every guy she brought around, not because they were bad people—but because none of them were him.

He loved her. Quietly. Painfully. He'd loved her for years, but he'd never said a word. He was content just being the person she called when she cried, the person who knew her favorite things, the person who stayed when everyone else left.

Until the last guy genuinely broke her.

That was when something in him changed.

He stopped hiding how much he cared. Started showing up more. Sitting closer. Holding her a little longer when she was upset. Letting himself look at her for a second too long when she wasn't paying attention.

And then New Year's Eve came around.

He remembered something she'd said months ago, almost jokingly.

*"I just want someone to kiss me at midnight."*

So when the countdown began and the entire room erupted into cheers, he found himself standing right in front of her.

Ten.

His heart hammered.

Five.

She looked up at him, confused.

Three.

He swallowed.

Two.

He finally leaned closer.

One.

And he kissed her.

His first kiss.

The girl he'd loved for years was the one who got it.

And for once, he wasn't going to pretend she was just his best friend.
typesense:trending.name: Elias
typesense:trending.title: kissing his best friend what could go wrong ?

title_i18n.ar: تقبيل أفضل صديق له، ما الذي يمكن أن يحدث بشكل خاطئ؟
title_i18n.de: Seinen besten Freund küssen – was könnte da schon schiefgehen?
title_i18n.es: besar a su mejor amigo ¿qué podría salir mal?
title_i18n.fr: embrasser sa meilleure amie, qu'est-ce qui pourrait mal tourner ?
title_i18n.hi: अपने सबसे अच्छे दोस्त को चूमना, क्या गलत हो सकता है?
title_i18n.it: baciare il suo migliore amico cosa potrebbe andare storto?
title_i18n.ja: 親友にキスするなんて、何が起こるかわからない？
title_i18n.pl: całowanie swojego najlepszego przyjaciela, co może pójść nie tak?
title_i18n.pt: beijando seu melhor amigo, o que poderia dar errado?
title_i18n.ru: Поцеловать своего лучшего друга — что может пойти не так?
title_i18n.tr: En iyi arkadaşını öpmek, ne yanlış olabilir ki?
